title.en: Marriage: Still Two People · Eight Languages

summary.en: The short guide and seven essays now add complete German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean editions. The supplied manuscripts were read against the current Chinese, with local corrections that preserve the warmth, examples and boundaries around care, children and leaving. Existing Chinese and English prose stays unchanged.
summary.zh: 一篇短导读与七篇正文新增德法西日韩五语全文。以现有中文逐篇核查来稿，局部校正语义与文风，保留亲近、支持、孩子与去留的全部例子和限定；原有中英繁正文不变。
summary.zh-hant: 一篇短導讀與七篇正文新增德法西日韓五語全文。以現有中文逐篇核查來稿，局部校正語義與文風，保留親近、支持、孩子與去留的全部例子和限定；原有中英繁正文不變。
